newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

CYPRUS, May 27 - Limassol - vessels due on 28/5, 1 container, 1 conventional vessel, 6 passenger. No delays expected. 9 container vessels discharging/loading at berth. 4 conventional vessels discharging at berth. 2 vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge/load. Larnaca - vessels due on 28/5, 1 container, 2 conventional. No delays expected. 1 container vessel discharging/loading at berth. 1 conventional vessel discharging at berth.

ISRAEL, May 27 - Haifa - two vessels due. Discharging at berth 1 general cargo, 4 bulk. 4 container vessels. 1 passenger. Waiting at anchorage to discharge 1 general cargo, 1 bulk. 1 vessel under repairs. Ashdod - two to three days delay.5 general cargo discharging at berth. 1 bulk loading at berth. 2 bulk discharging at berth. 1 passenger vessel. 2 general cargo vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge. Eilat - one tanker, 1 passenger vessel in port.

MOZAMBIQUE, May 26 - Nacala - port working normally (first come, first served basis). No restriction on berthing and sailing during night time. Draft restriction of 9.5 at general cargo berths and 14 metres at container berths. One tugboat available. Beira - general cargo berths working normally. 24 hour berthing/sailing for vessels up to 140 metres loa. Some restriction for larger vessels and subject to prior arrangements with port captain. Max. Draft for 24 hour navigation 7.5 metres. 2 tugs available.

General access channel - 2 waverider buoys have been deployed in the approach channel. Maputo - berthing/sailing of 24 hours for vessels up to 120 metres LOA. Some restrictions for larger vessels and subject to prior arrangements with port captain. All berths fluid. Draft restriction in the channel is 9 metres less 0.5 metres plus rise of tide of the day. max. draft for 24 hour navigation is 9 metres.
NAMIBIA, May 26 - Walvis Bay working normally.

SOUTH AFRICA, May 26 - Richard's Bay - port busy. Bulk import berths berth 702 occupied for discharge until mid-week, 702 fully occupied all week. Bulk export berths Berth 703/4 occupied. Bulk export berths 3 vessels alongside, 5 anchored, 16 due by 2/6. Delays of 3-4 days currently. Durban - delays of up to 72 hours expected. General cargo working normally. Bunker supplies normal but could change daily due to bunching. East London - general cargo/combi terminal/tanker berth busy but no delays. 2 tankers due weekly.

Port Elizabeth - four vessels in port. No delays on general, ore, tanker or fruit berths. 8 container vessels due. No delays expected. Vessels will have longer port stays due to only 2 gantries available. Cape Town - breakbulk (general cargo) berths, no vessels operating due to heavy rain, which could cause delays. Fruit berths fully occupied, but no work due to rain. Container terminal windbound and delays up to 24 hours expected. Bunker berths, vessels berthing and bunkering on arrival. No fuel oil stock until end of may. Drydock and repair quay fully occupied. Saldanha bay - working normally.

TUNISIA, May 24 - Sousse - no vessels in port. No waiting time. Sfax - five vessels operating of which 1 each discharging bulk sulphur, steel, general cargo, bulk wheat, 1 loading bulk rock phosphate. Tunis - three vessels awaiting instructions, 1 discharging timber. Rades - four ro/ro vessels in port. Mobil crane no. 1 will be out of service due to technical repairs from 26/5 to 31/5. Goulette - north side 1 passenger vessel, 1 vessel discharging tea, 1 discharging general cargo. South side 1 cereal vessel. No vessels in roads. May 27 - Bizerta - three vessels operating of which 1 loading white products, 1 loading cement, 1 discharging asbestos. No delays or congestion. Zarzis - no vessels.

TURKEY, Istanbul - May 26 - Haydarpasa 5 vessels operating of which 2 containers, 1 dry cargo, 2 ro/ro. No berthing delays. Galata - 7 cargo/passenger vessels operating. Port congested. Ambarli - 13 vessels operating. No berthing delays.

May 27 - Mersin - four vessels awaiting orders. 19 vessels operating of which loading 1 pipes, 1 pumice stone, 1 soda, 1 oil cake, 1 cement, 1 livestock. Discharging 1 each sugar, sand, bulk vegetable oil, wheat. Loading/discharging 1 container/vehicle/cargo, 2 vehicles, 5 container vessels. No vessels in free zone port. Seka - no vessels. Iskenderun - vessels discharging 1 leather, 1 logs. Loading 1 wheat. 2 anchored. Yazicilar - three vessels discharging scrap iron. 3 anchored.

Ekinciler - two vessels discharging scrap iron. Isdemir - one vessel discharging coal. 1 loading building iron. 1 anchored. Mersin - 12 vessels operating of which loading 2 cement, 2 barley, 1 pumice, 1 manure, 1 general cargo. Discharging 1 spirit, 1 general cargo, 1 sand, 1 crude oil, 1 rail. 9 vessels anchored.
